texts.preamble: Man Mohan Kumar Punia vs The District Appointing Officer on 1 December, 2021 Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan Crl.O.P(MD)No.18 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated : 01.12.2021 Coram : The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan Crl.O.P(MD)No.18848 of 2021 Man Mohan Kumar Punia ... Petitioner Vs. 1.The District Appointing Officer, Food Safety Department, Theni. 2.The Food Safety Officer, Allinagaram, Municipal Block, Theni. ... Respondents Prayer: This Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., to direct the learned Judicial Magistrate, Theni, to consi warrant recall application if any, filed by the petitioner under Section 70(2) of Cr.P.C. against the non bailable warrant issued by learned Judicial Magistrate, Theni in C.C.No.1808 of 2019 dated 13.09.2021 on his surrender on the same day. For Petitioner : Mr.S.Sivakumar For Respondents : Mr.T.Senthil Kumar, Addl. Public Prosecutor.
texts.facts: The petitioner is facing trial in C.C.No.1808 of 2019 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Theni for the offences under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Non bailable warrant has been issued against the petitioner. However, he is apprehensive that the recall petition may not considered on the same day and as a result, he may be remanded to custody. 2.I was inclined to allow the application straightaway. But then, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor pointed out that on account of the non-appearance of the petitioner before the trial Magistrate, Mr.A.Shanmugam, Food Safety Officer, Allinagarm, Theni, had to go all the way to Haryana along with four other police personnel to secure the petitioner herein. He had to spend a sum of Rs.25,000/-. The petitioner's counsel on instructions submitted that the petitioner would take a demand draft for a sum of Rs.25,000/- favouring the Designated Officer, Food Safety Department, Theni and hand over the same to the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis second respondent.
